name: What should I consider before choosing light fixtures for a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before choosing light fixtures for a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a small bathroom, consider fixtures that maximize light without overwhelming the space. Wall-mounted sconces on either side of the mirror provide excellent task lighting for grooming without taking up ceiling space. Recessed lighting is another good option for ambient light that blends seamlessly. Avoid overly large or ornate fixtures that can make the room feel cramped. Focus on clean lines and appropriate scale to enhance the functionality and perceived size of your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small bathrooms, choose fixtures that maximize light without overwhelming the space, like wall sconces or recessed lighting, focusing on scale and clean lines.
